scenario: A handler over the built-in `ComputationError` schema compiles with no schema declaration (LERR.9.4), and comparing `kind` against an in-set literal is accepted (LERR.9.2). Positive half of LERR.9.2_kind_closed.
rules_ds:
rule handler:
    ComputationError e where e.kind == "DIVIDE_BY_ZERO"
->
    log info "{e.rule}"
